name: TRIAERO 冠捷 A9 Pikachu / 105 Di2 R7170
why_interesting: The retained custom-painted A9 card maps to the indexed hand-painted Pikachu Shimano 105 Di2 R7170 option. The frame is well documented, but no exact complete-bike weight or full selected-option BOM was found.

facts.frame: TRIAERO A9 Toray T700 + T800 carbon aero road frame and carbon fork
facts.frame_material: Toray T700 + T800 carbon frame with carbon fork and seatpost
